text:
Partly. Volume and revenue were delivered, but margins and the telecom outlook fell short.

Met:
- The Q4 call guided "high double-digit" QoQ smartphone volume growth. Q1 delivered 7.5M units vs about 6M (+25%), and revenue rose 47.9% QoQ to Rs15,548cr. [Q4 FY26 call][Q1FY27 call][Numbers]
- IT hardware was guided above Rs4,000cr for FY27. Q1's Rs1,350cr annualises to about Rs5,400cr. [Q1FY27 call]
- The Rs56,000cr FY27 revenue target is intact. Q2-Q4 now need about Rs40,450cr, roughly +12% YoY. [Q4 FY26 call]

Missed:
- Management said the PLI-expiry hit of 50-70bps would be offset by efficiency gains. Instead, OPM fell to 3.0% from 3.8% and EBITDA dropped 4% YoY. [Q4 FY26 call][Numbers]
- The telecom guide of Rs7,500-8,000cr was cut to Rs6,700-7,000cr, even though Q1 came in at Rs2,100cr. [Q1FY27 call]

Not covered: whether Q1 realised the 12-15% price uplift.
